counts.question: 6. Graphify fit, without installing it
counts.answer: Languages: graphify parses everything here with tree-sitter: Python, JavaScript (.js, .jsx, .mjs, .cjs, with JSX elements counted as calls), TypeScript and TSX. At the frozen commit the repository has 218 .py, 52 .js, 65 .jsx, 2 .mjs, 109 .ts and 31 .tsx files. It resolves tsconfig and jsconfig aliases, re-exports and dynamic imports. Relation kinds it emits: calls, indirect_call, imports, imports_from, re_exports, contains, method, defines, inherits, implements, references (a decorator becomes a 'references' edge to the decorator's name), references_constant, uses_static_prop, bound_to and listened_by. Of the 18,875 edges at the frozen commit, 11,969 are of kinds graphify has an analogue for; that is an analogue kind, not verified to be the same edges. 4,604 have no analogue. These cover routes and HTTP (registers_route 85, calls_url 78, test_calls_route 441) and data (about 1,325 table, column, foreign-key and migration edges). They also cover mocks (93), settings (188), outbox kinds (45), import-linter contracts (254), co-change (1,896), invariant anchors (90) and mobile navigation (60). Routes are missing because a FastAPI route decorator keeps only the decorator name, not the path. Tables are missing because the SQL extractor reads .sql files and live schemas, and this repository has 0 .sql files. In the 12 sampled commits, 5 of the 31 needed-but-not-edited files were reachable only through route edges.
counts.how_measured: lane-graphify.md, plus graphify v0.9.108 (branch v8) extract.py and extractors/engine.py read as text, grepped for language configurations and relation literals. Edge counts come from the frozen facts snapshot's edges.jsonl. Graphify was not installed or run.
counts.consequence: G1 is runnable on every language here. It cannot answer cross-runtime or data questions, because it builds no route, URL or table edges. Those question kinds must be reported as their own stratum, where G1 is expected to fail for lack of the edge. Whether graphify's edges match ours in quality, and whether its update command works without .git, is unknown.
